entities.name: Kwende
entities.description: Human knight from Femeref on Dominaria, descended from followers of Mageta the Lion, who wields crystalline minotaur-made blades.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where Kwende's ancestors settled.

entities.name: Mageta the Lion
entities.description: Renowned Zhalfirin general who turned the tide against Keldon invaders and was phased out of time with Zhalfir.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Land phased out of time by Teferi's magic.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased Zhalfir out of time; Kwende tried to murder him.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: Invaders defeated by Mageta about 350 years earlier.

entities.name: Talruum Mountains
entities.description: Home of the minotaurs who made Kwende's blades.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: Event shortly after which Kwende tried to murder Teferi.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Kwende defended Dominaria.

events.summary: Kwende's ancestors, outside Zhalfir when Teferi worked his magic, settle in Femeref.
events.quote: Kwende's ancestors were outside Zhalfir when Teferi worked his magic

events.summary: Shortly after the Mending, Kwende attempts to murder Teferi as revenge for phasing Zhalfir.
events.quote: He attempted to murder Teferi , shortly after the Mending , as revenge for the phasing of Zhalfir.

events.summary: Kwende fights in defense of Dominaria during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Kwende fought in defense of Dominaria during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.note: Kwende tried to kill him over the phasing of Zhalfir.
Kwende is descended from followers of the general whom he idolizes.
relations.quote: He is descended from the Zhalfirin general Mageta the Lion whom he idolized.
